links.outcome: Model AUC on 2022 data with transfer learning versus models trained on older data
links.effect: Models trained on 2015-2020 declined in AUC from 0.81 to 0.74 (2021) and 0.68 (2022); Extra Trees transfer-learning ensemble reached AUC 0.87, F1 0.82 on 2022 data.
links.quote: A Extras Trees transfer-learning ensemble achieved the best temporal robustness (AUC 0.87, F1 0.82) on 2022 data, demonstrating improved adaptability to drift.

links.outcome: Performance after recalibrating or retraining models with recent data under temporal drift
links.effect: Transfer-learning ensembles improved adaptability to drift, reaching AUC 0.87 on 2022 data versus 0.68 for models trained on 2015-2020 data.
links.quote: Transfer-learning ensembles improved adaptability and maintained reliable, clinically relevant performance for particle-therapy toxicity prediction.

links.outcome: Decline in model AUC over time due to temporal data drift
links.effect: AUC fell from 0.81 internally to 0.74 on 2021 data and 0.68 on 2022 data; mucositis incidence rose from 27.3% to 60.4%.
links.quote: Models trained on 2015-2020 data declined in AUC from 0.81 internally to 0.74 and 0.68 on 2021 and 2022 data.
